what: Hand on the card: the Before image fades out in .16s and shrinks to .8x, while the After image starts at 1.15x, overshoots once by 1.36s, then pops into place at full size. When the hand leaves, After disappears in .24s and Before returns in .36s

ease.After: linear() overshoot curve — overshoots to 1.095, then bounces back and settles at .991 (original --ease-bouncy values as is, in fx.css)

options.--fx-from: Start scale of the later image (via style), default 1.15
options.--fx-shrink: Scale at which the previous image shrinks, default .8
